rules.content:
title: Sanctions Designation Infrastructure Migration
status: experimental
description: Detect infrastructure migration patterns following OFAC sanctions designations. Domains previously resolving to sanctioned entity IP ranges migrate to new hosting within 7-30 days of designation, reta
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: infrastructure_migration
    service: zone_file_diff
detection:
    selection:
        previous_ip_range_sanctioned|exists: true
        new_ip_range_different|exists: true
        ns_pattern_similarity_score|gte: 0.8
        migration_window_days|lte: 30
    sanctions_temporal_correlation:
        days_since_ofac_designation|lte: 30
        days_since_ofac_designation|gte: 0
    condition: selection and sanctions_temporal_correlation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0102: Sanctions Designation Infrastructure Migration (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Stablecoin Settlement Pattern Anomaly
status: experimental
description: Detect stablecoin transaction patterns consistent with sanctions evasion settlement. Identifies Monday-Friday volume surges with weekend drops (business settlement pattern), transaction clustering to 
logsource:
    product: crypto
    category: blockchain_analytics
    service: chain_monitoring
detection:
    selection:
        weekday_volume_ratio|gte: 3.0
        clustering_to_no_kyc_exchanges|gte: 0.6
    volume_pattern:
        stablecoin_type|contains:
            - "USDT"
            - "USDC"
            - "A7A5"
        daily_volume_usd|gte: 10000
    condition: selection and volume_pattern
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0103: Stablecoin Settlement Pattern Anomaly (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: BPH Rebranding Chain Detection
status: experimental
description: Detect bulletproof hosting providers that rebrand following law enforcement or sanctions action. Identifies new hosting entities advertising the same IP ranges, same BGP ASN prefixes, or same upstream
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: bgp_monitoring
    service: ip_allocation
detection:
    selection:
        new_entity_same_asn|exists: true
        new_entity_same_ip_range|exists: true
        new_entity_same_transit_provider|exists: true
        days_since_sanctioned_entity_shutdown|lte: 90
    condition: selection
level: high
rules.title: DL-0104: BPH Rebranding Chain Detection (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Sanctions-Announcement Infrastructure Correlation
status: experimental
description: Detect correlations between OFAC/EU sanctions announcements and subsequent infrastructure changes. Identifies new domain registrations by sanctioned entity-linked registrars, IP block migrations, and 
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: infrastructure_correlation
    service: sanctions_feed_enriched
detection:
    selection:
        new_registrations_from_linked_registrar|exists: true
        ip_block_migration|exists: true
        new_bgp_announcement|exists: true
        event_within_sanctions_designation|lte: "14d"
    condition: selection and temporal_correlation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0106: Sanctions-Announcement Infrastructure Correlation (Sigma)
